messages:
maria: quick heads-up — PR #1042 has a couple of lint/naming nits from CI after the kv cache rename. They look small but block the merge window today. can someone take a quick pass?

alex: can you paste the CI errors? I can try to fix if it's just naming/formatting.

maria: pasted below — mostly a mix of failing lints and one test that assumes old field name.

ci-bot: 
```
./pkg/serve/cache.go:45:8: type name will be used as kvcache.KVCache by other packages, and that stutters; consider calling this Cache
./pkg/config/defaults.go:23:17: exported const KvCacheTimeout should have comment or be unexported
--- FAIL: TestCacheKeySerialization (0.02s)
    cache_test.go:28: expected field "kv_cache_key" but got "kvCacheKey"
```

jing: looks like two issues: public type naming in pkg/serve (stutter) and a test expecting snake_case key. We should keep internal JSON/config keys snake_case but export types should be non-stuttering.

alex: ok — for the type name suggest renaming KVCache -> Cache in pkg/serve and keep package name kvcache so callers read kvcache.Cache which is fine. I can send a small change.

maria: yep that sounds right. also the test expecting "kv_cache_key" is in the serialization layer; we should keep that stable (snake_case) — so change probably only in the Go type name + add a compatibility json tag if needed.

alex: plan: 1) rename type KVCache -> Cache, 2) add `json:"kv_cache_key"` tag on field Key in the struct, 3) run `gofmt` and `golangci-lint run` locally, push branch. will do in a few mins.

sam: FYI aiming to cut the release branch at 16:00 PT — if this is merged before then we can include it. otherwise next window.

alex: pushed fix in branch `fix/kvcache-naming-1042` — link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1042/files (small rename + json tag + test update). kicked CI.

maria: thanks! i'll re-run the local failing test quickly.

ci-bot: status: running linters -> golangci-lint, unit tests.

alex: also left a short note in the PR description about the rename rationale to avoid future churn.

maria: saw it. one tiny nit from review: prefer `Cache` doc comment mention the package: `Cache is a lightweight KV cache used by kvcache package.` small wording tweak.

jing: +1 on wording nit, non-blocking but helpful.

ci-bot: linters passed. tests: running (3/3).

alex: updated comment, repushed.

ci-bot: all checks passed ✅.

maria: great — i'm approving now. :thumbsup: please squash-merge to keep history clean and use the PR title as commit message.

alex: will merge in ~5 if no objections.

sam: :shipit: thanks for the quick turnaround, team.

alex: merged and pushed to main. release note: "fix: resolve kv cache naming nits and preserve json key for serialization (PR #1042)"

maria: excellent — included in the cutoff. thanks everyone for the quick reviews!
